title: Research
description: A research project: its objective, its explicit scope and its lifecycle status.

research_id.description: Stable id for the research project.

domain.description: Top-level domain the project is filed under in the archive.

objective.description: What the research must answer; the reference for every action admission check.

keywords.description: Seed keywords used for source discovery and relevance judgement.

scope.description: Explicit scope. All three lists are required so that what is out of scope is a decision, not an omission.

related.description: Adjacent subjects worth following when a source is already being read.

excluded.description: Subjects deliberately left out; they become candidate research topics instead of polluting this archive.

time_window.description: The period the research targets. It orders results and drives default action windows; it never disqualifies historical material from the supplementary queue.

start.description: Start of the window, ISO 8601 date; null means open-ended.

end.description: End of the window, ISO 8601 date; null means up to now.

status.description: Lifecycle of the research loop: RUNNING while active, then one of the loop states.
